userStories.title: Toggle Socratic Mode
userStories.description: As a student, I want to enable Socratic tutoring, so that I can learn through guided reasoning.

userStories.title: Guided Question Generation
userStories.description: As a student, I want the AI to ask guiding questions, so that I can think critically before answering.
acceptanceCriteria: AI asks at least one guiding question
Question relates to current biology topic

userStories.title: Hint Progression System
userStories.description: As a student, I want hints to become progressively more helpful, so that I can eventually solve the problem.
acceptanceCriteria: Hints progress from broad to specific

userStories.title: Misconception Detection
userStories.description: As a student, I want incorrect assumptions corrected gently, so that I do not reinforce wrong biology concepts.
acceptanceCriteria: AI explains why reasoning is incorrect

userStories.title: Reveal Answer Fallback
userStories.description: As a student, I want to reveal the answer after multiple attempts, so that I do not get stuck indefinitely.
